The Denver Broncos. A professional American football franchise based in Denver, Colorado, competing in the National Football League.

Founded in 1960 as part of the American Football League before joining the NFL in 1970, the Broncos emerged as a major force in the nineteen-eighties and achieved their greatest success in the late nineteen-nineties and early twenty-tens. They are one of the oldest existing NFL franchises.

The Broncos won consecutive Super Bowls in the 1998 and 1999 seasons with quarterback John Elway, establishing the franchise's first dynasty. In 2015, with quarterback Peyton Manning, the Broncos won Super Bowl 50 with what many consider one of the greatest defenses in NFL history. Peyton Manning joined the Broncos after his neck injury and early retirement from the Indianapolis Colts, leading a remarkable resurgence at age thirty-nine.

Russell Wilson became the Broncos' quarterback in 2022, attempting to build a new era of success following Peyton Manning's retirement. The team plays their home games at Empower Field at Mile High, formerly known as Mile High Stadium, at high altitude in Denver—the Mile High City.

The franchise has consistently fielded competitive teams throughout its history, earning one of the NFL's higher win percentages overall. John Elway, after his playing career, became the Broncos' executive vice president of football operations, shaping the franchise's strategy and talent acquisition.

The 2015 Super Bowl 50 defense featured dominant pass-rushers and was led by Von Miller, who won the Super Bowl MVP award with a legendary performance. The Broncos' altitude advantage at Mile High Stadium has been a traditional home-field benefit, with visiting teams struggling to adapt to Denver's thin air. The franchise developed a strong rivalry with the Kansas City Chiefs and Pittsburgh Steelers, creating heated AFC West and divisional playoff matchups. Denver's sports culture embraced the Broncos as central to civic identity, with parade celebrations for championship runs drawing hundreds of thousands of fans.
